rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS)
rules.description: A string transformer that does not replace or escape all occurrences of a meta-character may be ineffective.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Writing incompletely sanitized values to HTML attribute strings can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Prepending a backslash to an ordinary character in a string does not have any effect, and may make regular expressions constructed from this string behave unexpectedly.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: Comparing the result of a typeof test against a string other than 'undefined', 'boolean', 'number', 'string', 'object', 'function' or 'symbol' is useless, since this comparison can never succeed.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If two functions with the same name are declared in the same scope, one of the declarations overrides the other without warning. This makes the code hard to read and maintain, and may even lead to platform-dependent behavior.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: When escaping special characters using a meta-character like backslash or ampersand, the meta-character has to be escaped first to avoid double-escaping, and conversely it has to be unescaped last to avoid double-unescaping.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
rules.description: A 'for' loop that increments its loop variable but checks it against a lower bound, or decrements its loop variable but checks it against an upper bound, will either stop iterating immediately or keep iterating indefinitely, and is usually indicative of a typo.

rules.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
rules.description: Sanitizing an HTTP request parameter may be ineffective if the user controls its type.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
rules.description: Building a shell command string with values from the enclosing environment may cause subtle bugs or vulnerabilities.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Authorization
rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Escaping code as HTML does not provide protection against code injection.
